changed.title: A fixed 128 by 128 graph given by its table: some AND/OR/NOT circuit of fan-in two with at most 1000 gates is right whenever one row and one column are on

Answer with a gate list (AND, OR or NOT, each reading at most two wires) and its output wire: only the gate list is checked, on the 16384 inputs with one row and one column on.
